start_about: Tukuna mai he taitara hei kupu noa (hei tauira, Berserk) ka tikina e au ngā upoko, ngā pukapuka katoa rānei hei pūranga CBZ/ZIP.

lang_prompt: 🌍 Kōwhiria tō reo: Ka matapae au i te reo mai i āu karere — engari ka toa tonu tō kōwhiringa ā-ringa.
lang_set: ✅ Kua whakaritea te reo ki te {name}.
help_flow: Me pēhea te whakamahi 1. Tukuna he taitara manga/ranobe hei kupu noa. 2. Kōwhiria te taitara tika ki ngā pātene (ka rapua e au ngā taitara me ngā taitara kē i ngā reo katoa). 3. Kōwhiria: ngā upoko 10 o muri, he awhe, he pukapuka, he upoko kotahi rānei. 4. Ka whakaurua e au te mahi ki te rārangi, ka tukuna ngā pūranga ki konei. Aroturukitia ki te /queue me te /status, whakamutua ki te /cancel.
help_zip_how: Me aha ki te .ZIP / .CBZ • He ZIP whārangi noa iho. Ko te .cbz = .zip he ingoa pai mō te kaipānui — hurihia noatia ahakoa pēhea. • Pānuitia ki te Mihon, te CDisplayEx, te Perfect Viewer, te YACReader — me wetewete noa rānei ka tirotiro i ngā whakaahua. • Ka tae mai ngā ranobe (ngā pukapuka) hei .epub — ka tuwhera i tēnā kaipukapuka, i tēnā.
help_zip_why: He aha te ZIP? He rau whārangi kei roto i te pukapuka kotahi. Pai ake te kōnae kotahi i ngā whakaahua 300 e waipuke ai te kōrerorero — he atawhai ki ngā rohe o Telegram, he atawhai hoki ki ōu kanohi. 😉
help_pack: Ngā momo pūranga (hurihia ki te /settings) • Merged (te taunoa): ko te pukapuka katoa hei pūranga kotahi, he tau whārangi haere tonu. • Per-chapter: he pūranga kotahi, kei roto e N ngā kōnae upoko motuhake. Ka tae mai ngā upoko kotahi hei kōnae kotahi i ngā wā katoa. Ko te rohe o Telegram he {mb} MB mō ia kōnae — ka tapahia aunoatia ngā pukapuka nunui ki ngā wāhanga tapanga.
